messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick sync — target to ship the new pricing slab + micro-estimator on Tue. Need final microcopy for the estimator, two tier-name variants, FAQ deltas, webinar blurb, and inbound routing rules. Who owns what?
Ravi Patel: I9ll take tier names + FAQ. Want to test spec-led vs outcome-led names: e.g., 'Starter  100k tokens' vs 'Productivity  for light ML infra'.
Ben Gomez: I9ll own calculator microcopy and webinar blurb. Brief only — calculator copy must be <140 chars for embeds.
Sam Lee: I9ll handle visual microcopy tweaks + truncation QA. Will mock tooltip copy for batching/cache.
Jordana Park: Routing: estimator leads should get tag 'estimator-prospect' and route to AM_pool_2. @marketing-bot can you add UTM+tag on capture?
marketing-bot: queued action add_lead_tag(estimator-prospect) -> send_to_queue(AM_pool_2). Confirm CRM schema.
Aisha Khan: Confirmed. @Ravi prioritize SLA and Dedicated pricing FAQ. Keep answers to 2 bullets max.
Ravi Patel: Draft FAQ bullets: 1) 'What's in Dedicated?  Reserved GPU capacity, predictable throughput, monthly commit.' 2) 'Bring-your-own-model?  Yes  Private & Dedicated support pinned model versions and custom images.' Feedback?
Ben Gomez: Calculator microcopy draft: prompt: 'Estimate monthly cost for X requests/day (avg tokens/request)'. Tooltip: 'Assumes baseline batching & prefix cache. Edit advanced settings to override.' Example snippet: ```requests_per_day: 50,000 avg_tokens: 60 batching: standard cache: enabled```
Sam Lee: Result card copy: 'Estimated monthly bill: $1,230 (incl. batching & cache).' CTA: 'Get a tailored quote' -> routes to AM_pool_2. Short and action-forward.
Jordana Park: Webinar blurb: 'Launch Lab: Cut LLM inference cost 3-5x — live demo of batching, quantization, and our estimator. Wed 10AM PT.' Registration ask: 'Are you evaluating Dedicated or Private?' -> used for routing.
Aisha Khan: A/B on tier names: Variant A (spec): Core / Scale / Enterprise. Variant B (outcome): Prototype / Production / Mission-Critical. Run 50/50 for 2 weeks; measure sign-ups + estimator engagement.
Ravi Patel: Will write two copy variants and one-paragraph rationale for the roadmap doc. Also add micro-FAQ about benchmarks: 'Benchmarks assume seq len 512 on A500 80GB; contact us for custom runs.'
Ben Gomez: Marketing short post: 'New pricing estimator + webinar — see how Redwood cuts per-token cost in real workloads. Register: <shortlink>' Keep <200 chars.
Sam Lee: I'll QA mobile truncation and post screenshots to #marketing-assets. Ping me when final copy is ready.
Jordana Park: I'll confirm CRM mapping: estimator-prospect tag + field evaluation_type populated from registration. Ops will test webhook.
marketing-bot: action_items: ['Ravi -> tier copy & FAQ bullets', 'Ben -> calculator copy + webinar blurb + shortlink', 'Sam -> mobile QA & tooltip visuals', 'Jordana -> routing rules & registration question']. Due in 48h.
Aisha Khan: One more — need a 1-paragraph benchmark narrative for the launch post, numbers-first. Who can draft by EOD tomorrow?
Ravi Patel: I9ll draft the numbers-first paragraph and post here by EOD.
Ben Gomez: I'll generate the campaign shortlink with UTM campaign=pricing-launch.
Sam Lee: Starting responsive QA now. Will loop in design for any truncation fixes.
Jordana Park: Coordinating ops tests; will confirm lead tag mapping when webhook test passes.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team! Report back here with final copy + assets. :rocket:
